description: This file defines the ComponentPluginManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing theme and module components, including discovery, validation, and instantiation of component plugins.

classes.name: ComponentPluginManager
classes.description: A plugin manager class in Drupal for managing theme and module components, handling discovery, validation, and instantiation of component plugins.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the ComponentPluginManager with dependencies like module handler, theme handler, cache backend, config factory, theme manager, component negotiator, file system, compatibility checker, validator, and application root.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a component instance by plugin ID, adding app root and schema enforcement to configuration, throws exception if component not found or invalid.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieves a component for rendering by negotiating the component ID and creating an instance.

methods.name: getAllComponents
methods.description: Returns all component instances managed by this plugin manager.

methods.name: clearCachedDefinitions
methods.description: Clears cached plugin definitions and related cache in the component negotiator.

methods.name: libraryFromDefinition
methods.description: Generates a library array (CSS/JS dependencies) from a component definition.

methods.name: getDiscovery
methods.description: Returns the plugin discovery object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: providerExists
methods.description: Checks if a provider (module or theme) exists.

methods.name: processDefinition
methods.description: Processes and augments a plugin definition, including category assignment.

methods.name: processDefinitionCategory
methods.description: Sets the category of a component definition based on its group or defaults to 'Other'.

methods.name: alterDefinitions
methods.description: Alters plugin definitions, validates replacements, and sorts by module weight.

methods.name: alterDefinition
methods.description: Adds computed properties to a plugin definition, including extension type, path, machine name, library, template, and documentation.

methods.name: isValidDefinition
methods.description: Validates a component definition using the component validator.

methods.name: getScanDirectories
methods.description: Returns directories to scan for components, combining module and theme component directories.

methods.name: translateLibraryPaths
methods.description: Adjusts library override paths to be relative to the library root.

methods.name: shouldEnforceSchemas
methods.description: Determines if schemas should be enforced based on provider type and theme settings.

methods.name: findAsset
methods.description: Finds asset files (CSS, JS, Twig) related to a component's metadata, optionally making paths relative.

methods.name: makePathRelativeToLibraryRoot
methods.description: Converts an absolute path to a path relative to the library provider root, typically '../' prefix.
